s01.finding: positive setup used a second Safari URL and did not prove the intended page was the current accessibility surface

s02.finding: dynamic BETA to ALPHA DOM text did not become observable in the fresh Safari accessibility snapshot; failure occurred at GOOD_SURFACE_NOT_CURRENT before the positive runTask

requiredClaims: Safari is blocked before evidence creation if it is already running.
The negative BETA surface rejects the ALPHA contract before perception-provider selection and before visual-fallback click delivery.
The same Safari tab and URL are retained for the positive case.
After the test-owned mode changes to ALPHA, the same page is reloaded and the server renders ALPHA in initial markup.
A fresh semantic snapshot verifies ALPHA exactly once and BETA absent before the positive runTask.
The positive runTask remains semantic-first and reaches visual fallback only after NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET.
Provider selection remains lazy and Computer Use-owned.
CLICK_POSTED remains delivery only and VERIFIED_SUCCESS requires independent post-action perception.
No screenshot bytes, OCR payload strings or coordinates are logged.
Cleanup and clean product trees are required.
nonClaims: No generic Safari visual fallback is authorized.
No built-in PROCEED contract is promoted.
No P3A matching, P5B eligibility, planner output or Computer Control contract is broadened.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P7 real evidence-backed application use case
